name: Gabriel
role: TFAH literary character (Milton's Paradise Lost) -- commander of the angelic guard at Eden's gate.
description: TFAH literary character. Category A: named archangel (Daniel 8:16, 9:21; Luke 1:19,26). Milton's assignment to command Eden's guard and confront Satan (Book IV) is biblical name, Miltonic scene. See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §V.
narrative_function: Confronts Satan at Eden's gate (Book IV); the golden-scales sign ends the confrontation.
